title: Need categories
description: Need categories of a region (goods and building needs) (CONTENT §2, D-031 – D-033): display data only. name is the player-facing name (1–32 printable characters); icon is a key of the HUD icon set (assets/icons/icons.json, e.g. "need:food"). Every goods need's category must be listed here.

group.description: Display group (D-065, e.g. security): categories with the same group are shown under one heading. Display data only.
